    • shortestPath

      public ArrayList<String> shortestPath(Town sourceVertex, Town destinationVertex)
      method to find the shortest path, could not get it to work so left empty in frustration
      Specified by:
      shortestPath in interface GraphInterface<Town,Road>
      Parameters:
      sourceVertex - starting vertex
      destinationVertex - ending vertex
      Returns:
      An arraylist of Strings that describe the path from sourceVertex to destinationVertex They will be in the format: startVertex "via" Edge "to" endVertex weight As an example: if finding path from Vertex_1 to Vertex_10, the ArrayList would be in the following format(this is a hypothetical solution): Vertex_1 via Edge_2 to Vertex_3 4 (first string in ArrayList) Vertex_3 via Edge_5 to Vertex_8 2 (second string in ArrayList) Vertex_8 via Edge_9 to Vertex_10 2 (third string in ArrayList)
